lines.text: The G-B-S Fit-Gap Workbench. Country fit-gap workshops – faster, consistent, and audit-ready.
Every country fit-gap starts from five capture workbooks – thousands of rows, pre-assessed by G-B-S Operations.
The workbench reads them as they are, in seconds. It's one offline file – no installation, no server, and no data leaving the laptop.
Before the workshop, a quality check shows Operations exactly which pre-assessment cells are still missing.
In the room, the team confirms the no-gap rows in bulk – and spends its time on the real gaps.
Every decision is logged – who, when, and in which session. A complete audit trail for the quality gates.
Effort is captured live, in hours per month, and converted into F-T-E – a clear baseline for the transition.
All deviations land on one board – with resolution approach, owner, and approval status.
Results flow straight into the deviation log, the Q-G-2 sign-off, and back into the original workbooks.
And several countries run side by side – one filter away.
One file. Every country. Decisions you can trace.
